testingContext: This is a Turborepo + Bun monorepo. ShipCode verification runs `bun run verify:affected`, which maps changed files to workspace packages and runs only package-local typecheck/test scripts sequentially. Do not use full-root `bun run test` or installer builds in automated tasks. Runtime/browser QA is per issue worktree: if a task needs frontend proof, create focused `.shipcode/runtime-tests/*.test.ts` tests and use safe test-auth fixtures, not real OAuth or personal credentials.
